Q001 Engineering Geology & Geomorphology

Q044 Deep Earth Seismology
GEO-2/21
🌍 P-Wave Core Transmission & PKIKP Phases
Which statement is true about P wave ?
(A) The P wave reflected from the mantle-core boundary.
(B) The P wave is transmitted through the outer core but reflected from the inner core.
(C) The P wave is transmitted through the outer as well as the inner core.
(D) The P wave is reflected from the crust-mantle boundary.
Verified Answer: Option (C) — The P wave is transmitted through the outer as well as the inner core. (Compressional P-waves penetrate both the liquid outer core as K-waves and solid inner core as I-waves: PKIKP)

Q045 Geophysics & Geodynamics

⚖️ Principles of Isostasy: Archimedean Gravitational Equilibrium
Isostatic equilibrium is :
(A) A buoyancy force pushing the lithosphere up equals the gravitational force pushing it down.
(B) A buoyancy force pushing the lithosphere up is less than the gravitational force pushing it down.
(C) A buoyancy force pushing the lithosphere up is greater than the gravitational force pushing it down.
(D) All the features of Earth's surface are at the same elevation
Verified Answer: Option (A) — A buoyancy force pushing the lithosphere up equals the gravitational force pushing it down. (Hydrostatic balance: Upward asthenospheric buoyancy = Downward lithospheric weight)

🚰 Constant Head Permeameter Limitations
Which of the following statements w.r.t. Constant Head Permeameter is not correct ?
(A) It is used to measure permeability of an aquifer sample in the laboratory.
(B) Undisturbed samples are collected from the field locations.
(C) It is suitable for measuring permeability of relatively fine-grained samples.
(D) The volume of water collected in a beaker after passing through the sample is measured and the time required is noted.

🥛 Electrical Conductivity (EC) to TDS Conversion Factor
Water with electrical conductivity value of 2500 micro siemens/cm (at 25°C) is considered suitable for drinking purpose. When expressed this drinking water standard in terms of TDS, the corresponding TDS value (in mg/l) would become :
(A) 1500 mg/l
